title: The equal oldest waiting times scenario expected the first project id even when the cursor lay between the two projects
resolution: Stated the round order relative to a cursor between the two project ids, and added a domain test and a shared queue conformance case for that cursor.

title: The verification record claimed the section 12 guarantee for any backlog although reads that end with the same project still starve the rotation
resolution: Narrowed the claim to the proven case, where the offer order equals the read order, and widened the cursor follow-up to reads ending with the same project, queued as advance-placement-rotation-cursor.
